name: Securities Index Report 1
definition: Provides details on the securities index request operations for national competent authorities.

TechnicalRecordIdentification.name: Technical Record Identification
TechnicalRecordIdentification.definition: Unique identifier of a record in a message used as part of error management and feedback messages.||Usage:|This identification will be used in the status advice sent back.

RequestingEntity.name: Requesting Entity
RequestingEntity.definition: Country code of the entity that wishes to express an interest in receiving transaction reports for the requested indexes.

Index.name: Index
Index.definition: Details the index that is being requested.

ValidityPeriod.name: Validity Period
ValidityPeriod.definition: Date when the national competent authority last expressed its interest in this index.
